#### ROC Curve
Do for one direction (up and then down)
Do one sided t test limma for mouse, fit, and human
Positive control: Human
Neg control: Random permutation


Import
```{r}
library(pracma)
#Import DEGs table
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file= here("tables", "dge_fit_mouse_human_long.rds"))
#ImmuneGO ontologies
ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes <- read_excel(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Mouse.xlsx")) %>% 
 separate_rows(genes)
immunego_btm_manual_grouped = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets.csv"))
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))
```


```{r}
######### UP -----------
#Do one sided t-test for each model
dge_long_genes_up = dge_long_genes %>% 
  # filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique())) %>%
  mutate(
    se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
    z = log2fc / se,
    pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = F), #onesided, p(gene) > 0 (right tail)
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj < 0.05, "up", "not_up")) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>% 
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#Assign human log2fc direction as truth
truth_human = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "direction") %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#Generate comparable distributions
perfect_prediction = truth_human %>%
  mutate(prob = adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = randperm(prob),
         organism = "Permutation")

uniform_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()),
         organism = "Uniform")

shuffle_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = sample(prob),
         organism = "Shuffle")

normal_prediction = perfect_prediction %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = rnorm(n(), mean = 0.5, sd = 0.1),
         prob= pmin(pmax(prob, 0), 1),
         organism = "Normal")

#Get only up and not up genes from models
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  mutate(
    se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
    z = log2fc / se,
    pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = F), #one sided, higher
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj < 0.05, "up", "not_up")) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>% 
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj) %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         prob = adj_p_val) %>% 
  #Add controls
  bind_rows(
    perfect_prediction,
    permutation_prediction,
    uniform_prediction,
    shuffle_prediction,
    normal_prediction
    )

#Get probabilities (UP)
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model = organism),
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(not_prob = 1 - prob,
         sum = prob + not_prob,
         truth = as.factor(truth)) %>% 
  distinct()


#Get ROC
roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Human", "Mouse", "Uniform", "FIT")) %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth, pred, model, prob, not_prob, sum) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up vs Non-Up")
```


Down vs not-down
```{r}
######### DOWN -----------
#Do one sided t-test for each model
dge_long_genes_down = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique())) %>%
  mutate(
    se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
    z = log2fc / se,
    pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = T), #onesided, p(gene) < 0 (left tail)
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj < 0.05, "down", "not_down")) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>% 
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#Assign human log2fc direction as truth

  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "direction") %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#Generate comparable distributions

  mutate(prob = adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = randperm(prob),
         organism = "Permutation")

uniform_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()),
         organism = "Uniform")

shuffle_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = sample(prob),
         organism = "Shuffle")

normal_prediction = perfect_prediction %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = rnorm(n(), mean = 0.5, sd = 0.1),
         prob= pmin(pmax(prob, 0), 1),
         organism = "Normal")

#Get only up and not up genes from models
models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique())) %>%
  mutate(
    se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
    z = log2fc / se,
    pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = T), #one sided, less
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj < 0.05, "down", "not_down")) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>% 
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj) %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         prob = adj_p_val) %>% 
  #Add controls
  bind_rows(
    perfect_prediction,
    permutation_prediction,
    uniform_prediction,
    shuffle_prediction,
    normal_prediction
    )

#Get probabilities (DOWN)
classified_df_probs_down = truth_human %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model = organism),
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(not_prob = 1 - prob,
         sum = prob + not_prob,
         truth = as.factor(truth)) %>% 
  distinct()


#Get ROC
roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Human", "Mouse", "Uniform", "FIT")) %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth, pred, model, prob, not_prob, sum) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down vs Non-Down")
```

```{r}
# Suponha um exemplo
log2fc <- 1.2
ci_low <- 0.8
ci_high <- 1.6
se <- (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96)

# Geração de x para a curva
x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = 500)
y_vals <- dnorm(x_vals, mean = log2fc, sd = se)

# Criar o data.frame
df_curve <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals)

# Plot
ggplot(df_curve, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low, ci_high), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "Normal distribution from log2FC ± CI",
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = "Density")
```


```{r}
#Manual example
dge_long_genes_up_example = dge_long_genes_down%>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         symbol == "TLR4") %>% 
  slice(3)

# Parameters
condition = dge_long_genes_up_example$condition
log2fc <- dge_long_genes_up_example$log2fc
# log2fc <- -0.15
ci_low <- dge_long_genes_up_example$ci_low
ci_high <- dge_long_genes_up_example$ci_high
z = dge_long_genes_up_example$z
pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = T) #one sided, higher
se <- dge_long_genes_up_example$se
direction = dge_long_genes_up_example$direction
df <- 120  #samples

# Null parameters
se_null <- se # Same SE
ci_low_null <- 0 - qt(0.975, df) * se_null
ci_high_null <- 0 + qt(0.975, df) * se_null

# x values (scaled for t-distribution)
x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = 500)
x_vals_null <- seq(-4*se, 4*se, length.out = 500)

# t-distribution densities
y_vals <- dt((x_vals - log2fc)/se, df = df) / se
y_vals_null <- dt(x_vals_null / se_null, df = df) / se_null

# Data frames
df_curve_gene <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals, distribution = "Observed")
df_curve_null <- data.frame(x = x_vals_null, y = y_vals_null, distribution = "Null")
actual_null_dist <- bind_rows(df_curve_gene, df_curve_null)

# Plot

# Destaque da cauda inferior da distribuição nula
shade_df_superior <- df_curve_null %>%
  filter(x >= log2fc) 

shade_df_inferior <- df_curve_gene %>%
  filter(x <= log2fc) 

ggplot(actual_null_dist, aes(x = x, y = y, color = distribution)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  
  # Área sombreada da cauda superior
  geom_area(data = shade_df_superior, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "black", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Área sombreada da cauda inferior
  geom_area(data = shade_df_inferior, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Linhas de referência
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_high_null), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low), linetype = "dashed", color = "lightblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "lightblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = paste0(condition, ", ", "adj_pval = ", as.character(pval_one_sided), ", ", direction),
       subtitle = condition,
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = "Density") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "lightblue", "Null" = "black"))

```


Automated
```{r}

#Plot T distributions
plot_t_distribution <- function(df, df_samples = 10, n_points = 500) {
  # df: data frame containing condition, log2fc, ci_low, ci_high, se columns
  # df_samples: degrees of freedom for t-distribution (default 120)
  # n_points: number of points for the curves
  
  # Function to create a plot for one row (one condition)
  create_plot <- function(row) {
    condition <- row$condition
    log2fc <- row$log2fc
    ci_low <- row$ci_low
    ci_high <- row$ci_high
    se <- row$se
    adj_p_val = row$adj_p_val
    direction = row$direction
    df <- df_samples
    
    
    # Null parameters (mean=0, same SE)
    se_null <- se
    ci_low_null <- 0 - qt(0.975, df) * se_null
    ci_high_null <- 0 + qt(0.975, df) * se_null
    
    # x ranges for observed and null
    x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = n_points)
    x_vals_null <- seq(-4*se_null, 4*se_null, length.out = n_points)
    
    # t-distribution densities
    y_vals <- dt((x_vals - log2fc) / se, df = df) / se
    y_vals_null <- dt(x_vals_null / se_null, df = df) / se_null
    
    # Data frames for plotting
    df_curve_gene <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals, distribution = "Observed")
    df_curve_null <- data.frame(x = x_vals_null, y = y_vals_null, distribution = "Null")
    actual_null_dist <- bind_rows(df_curve_gene, df_curve_null)
    
    # Plot
    p <- ggplot(actual_null_dist, aes(x = x, y = y, color = distribution)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.2) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_high_null), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low), linetype = "dashed", color = "lightblue") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "lightblue") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
      theme_vaxgo() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
            legend.position = "top") +
      labs(title = paste0(condition, ", ", "adj_pval = ", round(adj_p_val, 4), ", ", direction),
           x = "log2 Fold Change",
           y = "Density") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "lightblue", "Null" = "black"))
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Apply the plotting function to each row
  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) create_plot(df[i, ]))
  
  # Optionally, name the list by conditions
  names(plots) <- df$condition
  
  return(plots)
}
```


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}

df_example <- dge_long_genes_up %>%
  filter(symbol == "TLR8") %>%
  distinct(condition, .keep_all = TRUE)  # One row per condition

plots_list <- plot_t_distribution(df_example, df_samples = 100)

wrap_plots(plots_list, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = df_example$symbol, theme = theme(legend.position = "top"))
```

#### Confusion matrix
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(purrr) # Make sure this line is run before using reduce

##### Function
#Get summaries
get_confmat_summary <- function(data, model_selected, timepoint_selected) {
  data %>%
    filter(model == model_selected, timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>%
    conf_mat(truth, predicted) %>% # Assumes 'truth' and 'predicted' columns exist
    summary() %>% 
    mutate(model = model_selected,
           timepoint = timepoint_selected)
}


# Plot heatmap for every combination
plot_xconfmat_heatmap <- function(data, 
                                 model_selected, 
                                 timepoint_selected) {
  
  data %>%
    filter(model == model_selected, timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>%
    conf_mat(truth, predicted) %>%
    autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
    aes(
      fill = Freq,
      x = fct_rev(str_to_upper(Prediction)),
      y = str_to_upper(Truth),
      label = Freq
    ) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text() +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      x = "Predicted",
      y = "Truth",
      title = paste(model_selected, "Day", timepoint_selected)
    ) +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "white",
      high = "#80a1d4",
      n.breaks = 3
    )
}
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
filtered_df_confmat = classified_df_probs 


plot_params <- expand_grid(model = unique(filtered_df_confmat$model),
                           timepoint = unique(filtered_df_confmat$timepoint))


#Get performance
confmat_summaries <- map2_dfr(plot_params$model, plot_params$timepoint,
                               .f = ~ get_confmat_summary(data = filtered_df_confmat, # Pass your full data here
                                                           model_selected = .x,
                                                           timepoint_selected = .y))

confmat_summaries_plot = confmat_summaries %>% 
  filter(.metric %in% c("accuracy", "sens", wa)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = .estimate, x = model, fill = model, label = round(.estimate, 2)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(hjust = -0.2, vjust = 0.5, angle = 90, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.10)) +
  facet_grid(~paste("Day", timepoint) ~.metric) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse CI 30%" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Mouse CI 100%" = "#80a1d4",
    "FIT CI 30%"   = "#4361ee",
    "FIT CI 100%"   = "#dec0f1"
  ))

confmat_summaries_plot

confmat_summaries_plot %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "Conf_Matrix_FIT_Mouse_Summaries.png"),
       width = 10,
       height = 5)
```

```{r}

degs_segments <- degs_pos_neg_mouse %>%
  filter(quantile_label %in% c("Q25")) %>%
  mutate(quantile_label = if_else(quantile_label == "Q25", "<Q25", quantile_label)) %>% 
  bind_rows(degs_pos_neg_mouse_split %>% 
    mutate(quantile_label = if_else(quartiles_diff == "Q100" | 
                                      quartiles_diff == "Q75", "Q75>", 
                                    quartiles_diff)) %>% 
      filter(quantile_label == "Q75>")) %>% 
  arrange(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  group_by(human_symbol, quantile_label) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_human_next = lead(mean_human),
    mean_mouse_next = lead(mean_mouse),
    timepoint_next = lead(timepoint),
    direction = paste0("D", timepoint, "→D", timepoint_next)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_human_next), !is.na(mean_mouse_next)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!(mean_human == mean_human_next & mean_mouse == mean_mouse_next))
  
  

degs_segments
```
